name: Borg Babe Set
description:
It's truly one-of-a-kind. This Borg Babe Set is a 1/1 set of Hunnys Closet items for the much beloved Dolly [Ghostcam](https://buy.hunnys.io/portfolio/0x3a9a9b0a3148599DdE1660476c6a47b1272247C6) to play dress up with!


Owning this unlocks a special Hair Style, Accessory, and Outfit, all dreamt up by Ghostcam.


As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the Hunnys Closet, it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
